feedback.goal: Rebaseline the repository-local .dal evidence after preserving the controller foundation at a committed revision.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The reset dry run finds committed evidence, records the pre-reset revision, and reports no blocking condition.
The acknowledged reset removes the prior evidence tree, re-scaffolds the stores, and writes a schema-validated receipt.
The receipt binds the removed-store manifest to the committed pre-reset revision so prior evidence remains recoverable from version history.
The focused reset contract suite passes after the repository rebaseline.

outcome.summary: The prior .dal evidence was preserved at the controller commit, removed through the acknowledged reset path, and replaced by freshly scaffolded stores plus a provenance-bound reset receipt.

what_worked: Committing the pending controller feedback first satisfied the reset's recoverability guard.
The reset receipt binds the exact pre-reset revision and removed-store digest.
The focused reset contract passed all seven tests after execution.

evidence.summary: The controller foundation and its completion feedback were committed before evidence deletion, preserving the old tree in version history.
The pre-reset dry run reported 979 evidence files, a clean evidence tree, and no blockers at the committed controller revision.
The schema-validated receipt records the committed pre-reset revision, removed counts, and store-manifest digest; empty evidence stores were re-scaffolded.
The focused reset suite passed all seven tests.

notes: The workspace user explicitly requested the repository rebaseline.
The exact acknowledgement token authorized local evidence deletion; reset is not a sensitive-action approval.
